item.title: Takachiho Gorge — Guide
item.description: Takachiho Gorge, in the mountains of northern Miyazaki, is one of Japan’s most stunning natural landscapes. Formed when ancient lava from Mount Aso cooled and was carved by the Gokase River, the narrow gorge is walled by dramatic columns of grey volcanic basalt, rising up to 100 metres in beautifully symmetrical, folded formations. Down the middle flows the emerald-green river, and the slender Manai Falls tumbles some 17 metres directly into the gorge — the iconic view.
